The ATT is about **3.85**. Four of the five estimators I ran land on 3.85; the doubly robust one gives 3.86.

| Estimator | ATT |
|---|---|
| Regression imputation (outcome model fit on controls, all 25 covariates) | 3.847 |
| Inverse propensity weighting (logit propensity, ATT weights) | 3.848 |
| Nearest-neighbour matching (1:1 with replacement, standardized covariates) | 3.854 |
| Augmented IPW (doubly robust) | 3.856 |
| Naive difference in means (no adjustment, for reference) | 3.840 |

The data has 139 treated and 608 control units. I took "ATT" to mean the effect averaged over the treated group, with all 25 covariates as confounders, and reported the regression-imputation estimate as the headline because it is the most direct ATT estimator.

ANSWER: 3.85
